A thrombus is a localized hemostatic plug or blood clot in a
blood vessel. Thrombosis occurs when a thrombus causes blockage
in the blood vessel. This blockage can result in partial or complete
blood ﬂow obstruction either in larger vessels such as arteries or
veins, or smaller vessels collectively termed as microcirculation.
